tool_schemas.name: check-balance
tool_schemas.description: Returns the latest cached native-asset balance for the given (chain_id, address) and, when refresh=true, fetches the newest balance from Etherscan and persists it as the latest successful snapshot. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if chain_id is not a supported EVM chain ID or address is not a valid 0x-prefixed 20-byte hex string, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not allowed to use the tool, and RATE_LIMITED if the caller or upstream Etherscan quota would be exceeded (most commonly when refresh=true). Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when Etherscan fails or returns an unusable response, and NOT_FOUND when no successful snapshot exists and a refresh is not performed or does not succeed.

chain_id.description: EVM chain ID to query (e.g., 1 for Ethereum mainnet).

address.description: Ethereum address to fetch the native balance for (0x-prefixed hex).

refresh.description: If true, bypass cache and refresh balance from Etherscan (subject to rate limits).

tool_schemas.name: get-transactions
tool_schemas.description: Lists normal transactions for the given (chain_id, address), optionally filtered by start_block/end_block and sorted by sort, returning a single page of results using 1-based page and page_size; when refresh=true, the service refetches from Etherscan and updates the cached snapshot before serving the requested page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid chain_id/address, invalid sort, non-positive page/page_size, or an invalid block range (e.g., start_block > end_block), UNAUTHORIZED when access is not permitted, and RATE_LIMITED when request limits or upstream quota would be exceeded (especially on refresh). Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when Etherscan cannot fulfill the request, and NOT_FOUND when there is no cached snapshot available and refresh is not requested or fails.

chain_id.description: EVM chain ID to query (e.g., 1 for Ethereum mainnet).

address.description: Ethereum address to fetch transactions for (0x-prefixed hex).

start_block.description: Only include transactions with block_number >= start_block.

end_block.description: Only include transactions with block_number <= end_block.

sort.description: Sort order by block height/time (ascending or descending).

page_size.description: Number of transactions to return per page.

refresh.description: If true, refresh transactions from Etherscan and update cached snapshot.

tool_schemas.name: get-token-transfers
tool_schemas.description: Lists ERC‑20 token transfer events involving the given (chain_id, address), optionally filtered by contract_address and start_block/end_block and sorted by sort, returning a single 1-based page of results using page and page_size; when refresh=true, the service refetches from Etherscan and updates the cached snapshot. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid chain_id/address/contract_address, invalid sort, non-positive page/page_size, or an invalid block range (e.g., start_block > end_block), UNAUTHORIZED when the caller cannot access the tool, and RATE_LIMITED when caller or upstream Etherscan quotas would be exceeded. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when Etherscan fails or returns an unusable payload, and NOT_FOUND when no prior successful snapshot exists and a refresh is not performed or does not succeed.

chain_id.description: EVM chain ID to query (e.g., 1 for Ethereum mainnet).

address.description: Ethereum address to fetch ERC20 token transfers for (0x-prefixed hex).

contract_address.description: Optional ERC20 token contract address to filter transfers by (0x-prefixed hex).

start_block.description: Only include transfers with block_number >= start_block.

end_block.description: Only include transfers with block_number <= end_block.

sort.description: Sort order by block height/time (ascending or descending).

page_size.description: Number of token transfers to return per page.

refresh.description: If true, refresh token transfers from Etherscan and update cached snapshot.

tool_schemas.name: get-contract-abi
tool_schemas.description: Returns the latest cached contract ABI for (chain_id, contract_address) and, when refresh=true, refetches the ABI from Etherscan and persists the newest successful snapshot. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if chain_id is unsupported or contract_address is not a valid 0x-prefixed 20-byte hex string, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted, and RATE_LIMITED if request or upstream quotas would be exceeded (most commonly on refresh). Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when Etherscan cannot provide an ABI, and NOT_FOUND when no successful ABI snapshot exists and a refresh is not performed or does not succeed.

chain_id.description: EVM chain ID to query (e.g., 1 for Ethereum mainnet).

contract_address.description: Smart contract address to fetch the ABI for (0x-prefixed hex).

refresh.description: If true, bypass cache and refetch ABI from Etherscan.

tool_schemas.name: get-contract-code
tool_schemas.description: Returns the latest cached verified contract source code and associated metadata for (chain_id, contract_address) and, when refresh=true, refetches the verified source/metadata from Etherscan and persists the newest successful snapshot. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if chain_id is unsupported or contract_address is not a valid 0x-prefixed 20-byte hex string, UNAUTHORIZED if access is not allowed, and RATE_LIMITED when caller or upstream Etherscan quotas would be exceeded (especially on refresh). Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when Etherscan fails or returns an unusable response, and NOT_FOUND when no verified-source snapshot exists and a refresh is not performed or does not succeed.

chain_id.description: EVM chain ID to query (e.g., 1 for Ethereum mainnet).

contract_address.description: Smart contract address to fetch verified source code/metadata for (0x-prefixed hex).

refresh.description: If true, bypass cache and refetch source/metadata from Etherscan.

tool_schemas.name: get-gas-prices
tool_schemas.description: Returns the latest cached gas price estimates for the specified chain_id (in Gwei) and, when refresh=true, refreshes the estimates from Etherscan and stores the latest successful snapshot. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if chain_id is unsupported, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted, and RATE_LIMITED if request limits or upstream quota would be exceeded (most commonly when refresh=true). Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when Etherscan cannot supply gas estimates, and NOT_FOUND when no cached gas-price snapshot exists and a refresh is not performed or does not succeed.

chain_id.description: EVM chain ID to query for gas price estimates.

refresh.description: If true, bypass cache and refresh gas prices from Etherscan.

tool_schemas.name: get-ens-name
tool_schemas.description: Returns the latest cached ENS reverse-record name for the given (chain_id, address) and, when refresh=true, refetches the reverse record and stores the latest successful snapshot. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if chain_id is unsupported for the request or address is not a valid 0x-prefixed 20-byte hex string, UNAUTHORIZED if access is not allowed, and RATE_LIMITED if caller or upstream Etherscan quotas would be exceeded (especially on refresh). Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when the upstream lookup fails, and NOT_FOUND when no ENS name snapshot exists for the address and a refresh is not performed or does not succeed.

chain_id.description: EVM chain ID to query (ENS is typically available on mainnet).

address.description: Ethereum address to reverse-resolve to an ENS name (0x-prefixed hex).

refresh.description: If true, bypass cache and refresh ENS reverse record.

tool_schemas.name: list-requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists recorded tool invocations for auditing and debugging, filterable by api_key_id, tool_name, chain_id, subject_address, contract_address, status, and time range. Returns a single 1-based page ordered by created_at desc. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted to view request logs and RATE_LIMITED when the caller exceeds limits.

api_key_id.description: Filter to requests created under a specific API key id.

subject_address.description: Filter by normalized 0x-prefixed 20-byte hex subject address.

contract_address.description: Filter by normalized 0x-prefixed 20-byte hex contract address.

created_after.description: Only include requests with created_at >= created_after.

created_before.description: Only include requests with created_at <= created_before.

page_size.description: Number of requests to return per page.

tool_schemas.name: get-request
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single recorded request by id, including its upstream status and any recorded error fields. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist or is not visible to the caller, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted.

tool_schemas.name: create-api-key
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new API key for calling tools and returns the plaintext key exactly once along with the created api_keys record. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid limits/chains, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot create keys.

label.description: Human-readable label for the API key.

rate_limit_per_minute.description: Per-minute request limit to enforce for this key.

daily_quota.description: Maximum number of requests per day for this key.

allowed_chain_ids.description: List of EVM chain IDs this key may query.

tool_schemas.name: update-api-key
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on an existing api_keys record and can drive status transitions (active↔suspended and active/suspended→revoked). Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid transitions or malformed fields, NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot manage keys.

label.description: New label for the API key.

allowed_chain_ids.description: Replacement list of allowed chain IDs.

status.description: New status for the key. Only transitions allowed by lifecycle are accepted.

tool_schemas.name: update-address-state
tool_schemas.description: Updates an address_state row by (chain_id, address), including driving lifecycle status transitions (active↔stale, active/stale→blocked, blocked→active). Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid address/chain_id, invalid transitions, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted.

chain_id.description: EVM chain ID of the address_state row.

address.description: Ethereum address for the address_state row (0x-prefixed 20-byte hex); normalized lowercase on write.

status.description: New status for the address_state row. Only transitions allowed by lifecycle are accepted.

ens_name.description: Optional ENS name to store for the address.

ens_checked_at.description: Timestamp when ENS was last checked.
